t2.thesis: RIOT enters a BMO print after a ~33% monthly drawdown with a 16% implied move and an expected Q3 revenue/loss miss, but oversold, high short interest and a strong recent post-print record roughly offset the sector-wide pressure.
reasons: Base rate ~54% for BMO events; crypto_proxy cluster sample too small to use
Stock down ~40% in a month and 59% below its 52w high, so expectations are depressed and mean-reversion is possible
Sector headwinds persist: Keefe Bruyette cut targets and warned of a lease catalyst drought, Binance hack, financing fears
Last 4 prints all rose (+1% to +15%) despite big EPS misses; the market reacts to the AI lease story, not EPS
Entry is the open of the day before a BMO print, so the exit open is the reaction itself, a high-variance coin flip with an implied move of ~16%
t2.deciding_variable: Whether management gives concrete financing and timing updates on the 191 MW Rockdale lease (investment-grade backstop, Corsicana tenant) that ease funding fears.

prior.from: D004 base rates: overall validation 54.2%, BMO 54.8%; crypto_proxy cluster (n=8, insufficient) ignored

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. That earnings date (2026-11-04) is after today's date (2026-11-02) and past my knowledge cutoff, so I have no information on how RIOT's stock moved afterward.
t2.moved_from_prior: Down about 2 points from 0.54: the sector drift is negative and the consensus is for a wider loss, offset by the oversold setup and prior positive reactions.

theses.mechanism: Oversold stock, 15% short float and depressed expectations amplify any positive news on credit backstop or new lease progress
theses.wrong_if: Management is vague on financing or flags further delays

theses.expected: Selloff on weak mining results and capex or dilution worries
theses.mechanism: Revenue down and wider loss, higher mining costs, and a sector in a funding-fear regime pressure the stock
theses.wrong_if: Data center and engineering revenue beat and the stock gaps up

theses.expected: Muted move that is dominated by bitcoin and sector beta at the open
theses.mechanism: With the lease already priced in, the opening direction follows crypto and miner sentiment on Nov 3-4
theses.wrong_if: A large idiosyncratic surprise moves the stock more than 10%

key_observations: Financing update on the $573M Morgan Stanley facility and the investment-grade backstop
Data center revenue and AMD Phase 3 delivery on track for November
Corsicana tenant discussions and new lease timing
Cost to mine per bitcoin and bitcoin holdings or liquidity
Bitcoin price and miner peer moves into the print
